title: SCENES: Octatrack-style crossfader
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Two scenes, A and B, and a crossfader between them, after the Octatrack. TRK + FUNC opens the SCENES page. LEFT (or RIGHT) records scene A (or B): turn knobs on any audio track, then TRK + FUNC again; the sounds go back to how they were and the turned values are the scene. On the page every knob moves the crossfader, YES jumps to the other end, FUNC + LEFT/RIGHT clears a scene, NO closes. Scenes are saved; the fader starts at A. 0.3: DOWN on the page shows SCENE INFO, every value in the scenes with its A and B, and FUNC + LEFT / RIGHT / YES take one out of A, B or both; page keys close the page and go straight there; and the scenes go with the project when PROJECT LINK is in the build.
